egress.terms: Free; files served from files.slack.com -> files-origin.slack.com behind CloudFront

tooling: Slack Web API (files.getUploadURLExternal + files.completeUploadExternal), 1 GB per file; jeremy46231/slackfs (FUSE mount, 6 stars) exists but only mounts, does not add capacity
chaining: 5 GB x N free workspaces, but the one-year deletion makes it useless as an archive and the 90-day hide makes it useless as storage. Only viable as a transient relay.
limits_note: 5 GB workspace total; 1 GB per file; 10 apps max; content older than 90 days is hidden, content older than 1 year is permanently deleted (rolling, since 2024-08-26); high-volume upload throttling is explicitly mentioned in the free-plan limits
